source: Reproduction against unmodified policy production code; sanitized summary only

defects.expected: Two concurrent identical acceptance requests return 200 with one complete acceptance set
defects.actual: One request returned 500 after PostgreSQL uq_policy_acceptance violation; next statement failed with current transaction is aborted
defects.reproduction: PolicyIntegrationTest duplicateConcurrentAcceptanceCommitsBothRequestsWithoutPartialSet; barrier after both absence queries
defects.impact: Concurrent acknowledgements could fail despite idempotent intent
defects.fix: Native ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, stable version lock order; no caught database exception inside acceptance transaction

defects.expected: Unsupported policy edits return client errors
defects.impact: Misleading server error for unsupported requests; no policy mutation occurred
defects.fix: Preserve 405 and Allow header for unsupported methods, 404 for unmapped resource paths

defects.expected: Missing required type must never display all-required-reviewed success
defects.actual: Four published versions accepted; backend completeness false, policy centre claimed all current required policies reviewed
defects.impact: Misleading review completion while commitments remain blocked
defects.fix: Use backend completeness and full displayed type set; show missing-set notice

harnessCorrections: Repository spy barriers delegate to the Spring Data proxy default answer, not abstract callRealMethod
Owner payout browser fixture requires completed owner verification and opening Add payout details
Paid cancellation fixture requires confirmation cancellation snapshot and refund amount value/currency in the actual DTO order
legal: No legal wording or policy-enforcement rules changed
